name: google-hotels
description: Live Google Hotels and Google Vacation Rentals price search with per-OTA nightly rates (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Vrbo, Airbnb, Hotels.com and 10+ other providers) and a 3-month daily price calendar for any single hotel. Pay-per-use via Apify.

APIFY_TOKEN.description: Your Apify API token (free account at https://apify.com; pay-per-event: ~$0.002/hotel, ~$0.0015/calendar date, ~$0.002/rental)

uvx.description: Run via uvx (recommended; no local checkout needed)

examples.title: Search hotels in a city
examples.description: Search Google Hotels for a destination + date range.
examples.prompt: Find 4-star hotels in Paris for 3 nights from 2026-12-20, two adults, in EUR, with the Booking.com and Expedia rate for each one.

examples.title: Pull a 3-month daily price calendar
examples.description: Get one row per date for a specific hotel URL.
examples.prompt: Pull a 3-month daily price calendar for the Hoxton Paris — I want to see which dates are under 200 EUR.

examples.title: Search vacation rentals
examples.description: Search Google Vacation Rentals across Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com.
examples.prompt: Find 3-bedroom vacation rentals in Lisbon from 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-17 under 250 EUR per night.

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Search Google Hotels for a destination and date range. Returns name, rating, review count, nightly and total price, hotel class, address, coordinates, amenities, hero photo and Google URL. Set include_provider_prices=true for per-OTA nightly rates.

tools.name: search_vacation_rentals
tools.description: Search Google Vacation Rentals (Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com) for a destination and date range. Same shape as search_hotels plus bedrooms/bathrooms.

tools.name: hotel_price_calendar
tools.description: Fetch a 3-month daily rate calendar for a single hotel URL. Returns one row per date with price, currency and availability.

hotel_url.description: A Google Hotels URL (/travel/hotels/entity/...) or googleHotelId
